affected_system: urban water supply, distribution, and conservation system
alternatives: expand non-potable reuse where treatment and demand align
select a diversified supply, efficiency, and renewal portfolio
assumptions: Supply, demand, leakage, and storage balances use reconciled units and meter coverage.
Restriction response and climate sequences are observed inputs or labeled scenarios.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.

constraints.description: Selected projects must fit capital, energy, treatment, maintenance, and delivery-capacity limits.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: water utility general manager and drought-response lead
decision_question: Which investments best reduce shortage and failure risk within capital and operating limits?

independence_key.binding_constraint: Selected projects must fit capital, energy, treatment, maintenance, and delivery-capacity limits.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Project yield, reliability, cost, energy, permitting, dependencies, and delivery evidence are independently reviewed.
independence_key.primary_outcome: expected annual shortage and leakage volume

intended_claim: A versioned prioritize design for comparing declared alternatives affecting water-security capital and conservation portfolio, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: expected annual shortage and leakage volume
distributional gap in expected annual shortage and leakage volume
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report modeled yield or avoided shortage as delivered water.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Project yield, reliability, cost, energy, permitting, dependencies, and delivery evidence are independently reviewed.

title: Prioritize leakage, reuse, and supply-reliability investments
transportability_risks: Water rights, source portfolios, pricing, metering, leakage, and climate regimes differ.
Household conservation behavior may not transfer across tariff and tenure systems.
